grammarFocus: 条件句；数量词；段落间的指代与衔接。
title: The Community Garden Plot Plan
instructions: 阅读下面的短文，回答10个问题。文章和题目均为模拟教学材料，不是官方雅思试题。请先通读全文，再作答。答案必须来自原文。
passage:
Last spring, the residents of Maple Court decided to turn an empty corner of their housing area into a community garden. The plan sounded simple: divide the space into small plots, give each family one plot, and let everyone grow vegetables. But the project quickly became a lesson in resource allocation and stage checks.

A. The first problem was the land itself. The corner was not a perfect rectangle. It was about 20 metres long and 12 metres wide, but a large tree stood near the middle. The tree could not be moved. So the garden team measured the open ground carefully and found that they could make 14 plots of equal size if they left a path around the tree. Each plot would be 2 metres by 3 metres. That was enough for a few tomato plants, some beans, and a small area for herbs. The team wrote the measurements on a board and put it near the entrance so that everyone could see the plan.

B. The second problem was people. More than 30 families wanted a plot, but there were only 14 plots. The team had to decide who would get one. They agreed on three simple rules. First, families with young children or elderly members could have one plot first, because gardening is good exercise and fresh vegetables are healthy. Second, a family could have only one plot, not two. Third, anyone who received a plot had to help with the shared path and the water system for two hours each month. The team posted the rules and asked families to sign up. In the end, 14 families got plots, and 18 families joined a waiting list. The team promised to check the waiting list every three months.

C. The third problem was water. The garden had no tap. The team collected rainwater in two large barrels near the tool shed. Each barrel held about 200 litres. In dry weeks, the barrels were empty in three days. So the team set a rule: each plot could use only 20 litres of water per day. They also asked families to water their plants in the early morning or late evening, when the sun is not strong. This simple stage check—looking at the water level every evening—saved the garden during a hot July.

D. By August, the garden was full of green leaves and bright flowers. The team held a short meeting every month to check progress. At each meeting, they asked three questions: Is the path clean? Is there enough water? Are there any problems between neighbours? These checks helped the group solve small issues before they became big ones. For example, when one family's tomato plants grew too tall and blocked the path, the team asked them to tie the plants to a stick. The problem was fixed in one afternoon.

E. The garden also taught the residents about fair sharing. When the first beans were ready, the 14 families with plots gave some beans to the families on the waiting list. Everyone agreed that this was fair, because the waiting families had helped with the path and the water barrels even without a plot. The team now plans to open a second garden area next year. They will use the same rules, but they will start the sign-up earlier and check the water system every week, not every month. The residents learned that good plans need clear numbers, fair rules, and regular checks.

grammar.title: 条件句；数量词；段落间的指代与衔接
grammar.explanation: 条件句用if引导，表示“如果……就……”，如If it rains, we will stay home。数量词如some, any, many, much, a few, a little等，用来表示数量。段落间的指代与衔接指用代词（如they, this, these）或连接词（如however, therefore, for example）把段落连起来，使文章连贯。
grammar.example: If they left a path around the tree, they could make 14 plots.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: If each family _____ one plot, there will be enough space.
questions.explanation: 条件句主句用将来时，if从句用一般现在时，主语each family是单数，所以用takes。
questions.evidence: If they left a path around the tree, they could make 14 plots.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word: There are _____ families on the waiting list, but only _____ water in the barrels.
questions.explanation: families是可数名词复数，用many；water是不可数名词，用a little。
questions.evidence: More than 30 families wanted a plot, but there were only 14 plots.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct word to connect the paragraphs: The garden had no tap. _____, the team collected rainwater in barrels.
questions.explanation: 前后是因果关系：没有水龙头，因此收集雨水。
questions.evidence: The garden had no tap. The team collected rainwater in two large barrels near the tool shed.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct pronoun: The team posted the rules and asked families to sign up. _____ promised to check the waiting list every three months.
questions.explanation: The team是集体名词，这里指团队成员，用they指代。
questions.evidence: The team promised to check the waiting list every three months.
